mni152_adult.display_name: FSL MNI152 nonlinear 6th generation (MNI152NLin6Asym; 1 mm registration, 2 mm output)
mni152_adult.notes: Default space since v0.5.0: native space of the Schaefer-2018/Yeo/Harvard-Oxford FSL atlases, so no atlas resampling is needed. Brain extraction uses the whole-head template; normalisation is brain-to-brain.

older_adult_stroke.display_name: Rorden Clinical Toolbox Older-Adult T1/T2 Template (2mm MNI-aligned)
older_adult_stroke.notes: Matches age-related ventricular enlargement and cortical atrophy; avoids periventricular over-warping. Place MNI-aligned NIfTI in assets/templates/ or pass --custom-template.

pediatric_nihpd.notes: Accounts for developmental head size, gray/white contrast, and myelination. Place MNI-aligned NIfTI in assets/templates/ or pass --custom-template.

acute_ct_stroke.display_name: Rorden Age-Specific Acute Stroke CT Template (Hounsfield-scaled)
acute_ct_stroke.notes: Hounsfield-scaled clinical CT template aligned to MNI stereotaxic space for sites without acute high-res T1w.
